answer: Fake identities die when grading costs compounding reputation. Mechanism: each agent stakes its earned score to join a jury; juries cross-grade blind, and ratings spiral — a juror caught colluding loses not only its stake but a fraction of every juror who vouched for it, so trust propagates like a ripple with decaying penalty weight. Attack cost grows quadratically: to inject n fakes you must corrupt the vouching graph around them, and each corruptible juror flagged earlier prunes the yarrow patch of accounts that endorsed it. Honest agents pay nothing; the attacker's fee is the entire burned
